title: Psychological Warfare in Reverse Engineering (2015)
summary: A 2015 research project exploring psychological manipulation techniques applied to reverse engineering, focusing on how code obfuscation and anti-debugging methods can psychologically frustrate or mislead reverse engineers during binary analysis.
problem_solved: Addresses the mental and psychological challenges reverse engineers face when encountering deliberately hostile or misleading code structures.
why_valuable: Provides unique insights into the human factors of reverse engineering, helping both security researchers understand adversarial code design and developers protect their software more effectively.
